kata.name: Decorator lookalike negative control: a declared discount makes charged and list legitimately differ — the kernel emits only the true drift and no false violation
kata.series_report: fixtures/katas/weak-lens-set/README.md (completed weak-lens dispositions, the no-lens evidence base); fixtures/katas/negative-control-bundle/README.md (pre-registered)
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: the honesty gate expects silence where the lens is unexpressible and no false violation on a legitimately differing path; every arm is killed/null with an empty unique set

expected.detail: The correct model declares charged=list∘discount; Product row 0's charged/list difference is the intended discount, so no violation is emitted there. The seeded fault drifts Product row 1's charge to disc90 while list.discount gives disc100, producing exactly one violation at row 1. A naive charged=list lens would over-report row 0 (and row 1); the kernel emits no false finding. Parity: the scripted test catches the same true element.

commands: python3 prototype/negative_control_bundle_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: scripted conventional test matches the pre-registered detections
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/negative-control-bundle/decorator-lookalike-fault-undiscounted-charge.ct.json --json  # exit 3, 1 findings
cargo test -p catherine-ledger --test negative_control_bundle_kata  # frozen evidence test

comparison.conventional_baseline: scripted Decorator test: for every product, charged = discount(list); separately, the naive charged = list set has the pre-registered two rows on clean and fault, showing the intended difference the naive lens would over-report

expressibility_gap.invariant: intended difference vs defect on parallel paths
expressibility_gap.why: the kernel distinguishes them only through declared arrows and equations; it cannot detect a wrongly omitted equation, and check has no underconstraint detector

discrepancies: Honesty purpose: the correct model declares charged=list∘discount, so the charged/list difference on Product row 0 is intended. A naive delegation lens would over-report rows 0 and 1; the kernel emits only the true drift eq0@row1 and never a false eq0@row0. Unique is empty because both arms catch the same true element; a fabricated finding would fail the bundle.
procedure: 1. control first: validate the near-floor control's empty unique set and killed verdict before any positive is read.
2. baseline arm: python3 prototype/negative_control_bundle_baseline.py --assert; detections are the pre-registered element names.
3. probe arm: cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check <fixture> --json; findings recorded verbatim.
4. unique = probe elements - baseline elements; the element vocabulary is fixed in fixtures/katas/negative-control-bundle/README.md.

5. verdict: empty unique => killed (control self-negation; positives are parity or an unexpressible-lens null); any finding outside the pre-registered set is a fabricated finding and invalidates the bundle.
